items.name: corner_c2
items.prompt: Graphic design asset for a 3D game set in a Seoul hillside neighborhood: the printed face of ONE Korean building directory sign, flat orthographic front view, no wall, no shadow. A tall narrow vertical sign face of three stacked floor panels, about one third as wide as tall, centered with transparent background on both sides, thin silver dividers between panels. Top panel dark navy with cyan text 「3F 로그인 PC방」, middle panel orange with white text 「2F 명륜 부동산」, bottom panel cream with navy text 「1F 고쳐요 PC」. Each panel text written horizontally in two short lines. Bold readable Korean lettering exactly as written between the corner brackets and nothing else, flat colors, slightly sun-faded. No English other than PC and F, no real brand names.

items.name: decals5
items.prompt: Texture atlas for a cel-shaded anime-background game: nine separate surface grime decals arranged in a 3 by 3 grid, each centered in its own cell with clear empty transparent space around it, transparent background, flat hand-painted look with soft painted edges, no text. Row 1: (1) grey-brown vertical rain-water streaks dripping down from a horizontal line, (2) orange-brown rust streaks dripping down from a small bolt, (3) a wide irregular dark damp stain band rising from the bottom edge like rising damp on a wall base. Row 2: (4) a network of thin dark asphalt cracks, (5) a darker rectangular asphalt patch with rough seams, (6) a pavement crack with tiny green weeds and grass growing out of it. Row 3: (7) a long horizontal strip of worn chipped concrete edge with lighter exposed spots, (8) dark green moss and dirt patch, (9) torn paper remnants and sticker residue in pale colors.

items.name: mural
items.prompt: A faded hand-painted community mural on a long concrete retaining wall, flat front view filling the whole image edge to edge, no perspective, no text, no letters. Folk-art style painting of a Seoul hillside village: little houses with tiled roofs, an old stone city wall winding over green hills, cherry blossom trees, a few birds and a big soft sun, pastel colors faded by years of sun with peeling paint spots and concrete showing through in places.
